Hi Ella —

Thanks again for taking the time on the discovery call last week. I scheduled a technical walkthrough for Tuesday, Jun 22 at 11:00am PT to cover integration touchpoints (SSO, data flows, inference routing) and a short Q&A with our infra engineer. I attached the technical deck and a short integration checklist to this thread.

Quick asks before the session: could your procurement/security team confirm whether an NDA and the vendor intake questionnaire are required in advance? If so, please share the link or the latest form so we can get ahead of it — we want the session to focus on technical fit, not intake logistics.

If the intake steps need to complete first, we can pause the walkthrough and pick a new date after those are done. Proposed alternate windows: Jun 29–Jul 1, or Jul 6–8.

Best,
Sofia

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the invite. Heads up: our security and procurement teams require vendors to complete an onboarding intake before any live technical demos involving product or infra details. That includes:
- Executed NDA (we can send via DocuSign)
- Completion of our vendor security questionnaire (we host it on our intake portal)
- Basic vendor insurance certificate for proof of coverage (if available)

I've looped procurement on this thread. Procurement — can you confirm the intake link and an estimated timeline? We have an internal review cadence; usually this is 5–10 business days depending on workload.

If we can't complete intake by Jun 22, can we reschedule the walkthrough to the first available window after intake is complete?

Thanks,
Ella Thompson
Director, Partnerships | Aurum Health
